subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should the first supported surface use model-scoped Anthropic parameters and defer pause-after-compaction, rather than add agents.defaults.compaction.serverSide or reuse the existing compaction.provider field?
rationale: The existing provider field selects a plugin-owned local summarizer, while Anthropic server compaction changes provider requests and persisted transcript semantics; selecting its public owner and initial behavior is a compatibility-sensitive product decision.

options.title: Model-scoped Anthropic parameters
options.body: Add semantic Anthropic-only enablement, trigger, and instruction parameters with typed block replay, while deferring pause mode.

options.title: Global compaction subobject
options.body: Add an Anthropic-native mode under the global compaction object, accepting broader core configuration coupling.

options.title: Defer native support
options.body: Retain local and plugin compaction only until Anthropic's beta contract and desired loop behavior are considered stable.

recommendation.title: Model-scoped Anthropic parameters
recommendation.body: Add semantic Anthropic-only enablement, trigger, and instruction parameters with typed block replay, while deferring pause mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and the prior review connect this person to the configuration, compaction, provider, and agent-loop surfaces involved in the decision.
